mapper.select: select pm.product_id, pm.product_name, afm.attached_file_path, cm.card_id, cm.card_name, sc.comment, sc.is_anonymous, sc.quantity, pm.amount from shopping_cart sc INNER JOIN product_master pm ON pm.product_id = sc.product_id INNER JOIN card_master cm ON cm.card_id = sc.card_id INNER JOIN attached_file_master afm ON afm.attached_file_id = pm.attached_file_id where sc.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS shoppingcartCount FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{user_id} AND product_id = #{product_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopping_cart (user_id, product_id, card_id, quantity, is_anonymous, comment) VALUES (#{cartItem.user_id}, #{cartItem.product.productId}, #{cartItem.card.card_id}, #{cartItem.quantity}, #{cartItem.is_anonymous}, #{cartItem.comment})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{user_id} AND product_id = #{product_id}
